body.name: v0.6.0
body.body:
# What has changed?

- iDescriptor is now fully GPU rendered
- AirPlay issues with newer devices are fixed (#84)
- AirPlay is now GPU accelerated (OpenGL)
- AirPlay now supports audio, zoom and rotation control (#99)
- Transfers are now much faster (going up to 40MiB/s when wired) (#95) 
- New experimental backup feature (#49)
- Albums now appear just like the Photos App on the device (#2)
- Fixed login issues with Apple ID (#104)
- Fixed file dialog issues on macOS 26 (#63)
- Linux Arm builds are now available (#38)
- Brand new navigation and app design
- Fixed wireless pairing issues (#78), (macOS still has some issues because of the platform)
- Add translation support and German translations

We have rewritten the dependencies we depend on in Rust

- **`ipatool`**: previously  we were using patched ipatool, now as Rust crate https://crates.io/crates/ipatool
- **`ifuse`**: previously  we were using libimobiledevice's ifuse but now we use the Rust crate https://crates.io/crates/ifuse
- **`irecovery`**: this was required for recovery devices now we use https://crates.io/crates/irecovery

We have put so much time and effort into this update as always, please consider sponsoring the project.

**Flatpak and Windows store versions will be released in a few days**

body.name: v0.5.0

IMPROVEMENT: AirPlay now uses legacy ports by default on Linux (thanks @medaminezghal, #73)

body.name: v0.4.0
body.body:
## What's new in this release?

- **Wireless device support**:  Yes, you can now connect to your iDevice wirelessly

- **iOS 17+ support**:  Previously, you could not use virtual location and other features on iOS 17 and above, but now you can!

- **Status Balloon**:  We have added a status widget that shows ongoing operations (exporting, importing, etc.) and their progress

- **Moved to Rust**:  We have moved the backend to Rust, which has improved performance and stability.

- **New UI**:  We have huge UI improvements for Windows 11 (Mica effect), we will be improving the UI for other platforms in the future.



Since we moved to a Rust backend, old device support (iOS 10 and below) isn't as good as it used to be but we will be improving it in the future.
